data.narrative:
Resilience is a Series D biotech company that has raised approximately $600M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three public Biotech & Health companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and eight private-stage peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit, all operating in the same sector and at comparable or adjacent funding stages.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D advancement, yielding $900M from the $600M raised baseline. Peer-median analysis anchors to three same-sector, adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $3.8B (ranging $3.1B–$10.3B). Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied as Resilience's revenue is not on file, limiting the utility of the 6.2x median P/S multiple observed across public Biotech & Health names.

The triangulation across applicable methods supports a valuation range of $765M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.4B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty: the stage-progression method anchors conservatively to capital deployed, while the peer-median approach captures realized market valuations but reflects heterogeneous risk profiles within the peer cohort. The extreme outlier (Colossal at $10.3B) underscores valuation dispersion in frontier biotech. Critical unknowns include Resilience's revenue trajectory, clinical-stage advancement, and comparable risk positioning relative to the peer universe.
